title: Spatial Research Object & Cross-Product Handoff Registry

targets.label: Workspace
targets.description: Portable project state, evidence references, analysis state and resumable spatial context.

targets.label: Knowledge Library
targets.description: Evidence/source bundle suitable for preservation, cataloging and research-package composition.

targets.label: Research Librarian
targets.description: Research question, scope, evidence lineage, source authority context and explicit evidence gaps.

targets.label: Research Lab
targets.description: Reproducible study inputs, query/graph references, hypotheses and method context.

targets.label: Workbench
targets.description: Computational inputs, geometry/time scope, evidence digests and analysis references for calculation/modeling.

targets.label: Decision Studio
targets.description: Decision context with exposures, scenarios, assumptions, uncertainties and supporting evidence references.

targets.label: Platform Core
targets.description: Canonical object/provenance contract for cross-product identity and lineage exchange.
